text: BAM share rose 0.22 percentage points over 22 hours and 0.26 percentage points over 7 days, to 37.7%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 26.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
